what: Audited pickup evidence and randomized target mapping
why: Prevent elevated objects, stale snapshots or mismatched targets from being reported as successful grasps
details: Seven conservative verification tests and six planner tests pass. The verifier requires the exact target, supported objective, fresh finite measurements, gravity, free-body simulation, returned API action and observed joint movement.
Measured lift and verified grasp are distinct. Current runtime height evidence alone cannot prove gripper support; independent review remains necessary.
Web audit fixes preserve completed statuses on unselected tables and keep stale camera ages advancing. Final results show target, rise and hold duration.
Worker integration and subsequent live pickup verification are pending; no new inference requests were submitted by this audit.

Configured fixture plans now preserve their structured objective, object layout, target and starting pose unless rearrangement is explicitly requested. This prevents the plan layer from silently discarding test setup.
